This section is reserved for songs, hymns, chants, lyrics, recordings, and other musical or liturgical material.

No song materials have been added yet.

## Suggested Future Structure

- Lyrics or hymn texts as Markdown reading copies.
- Source files, recordings, drafts, or scans in `raw/`.
- Public-facing notes about theme, scriptural references, meter, usage, and authorship.
